strings.name: Hirokazu Kore-eda
strings.summary: Kore-eda began in television documentary and entered fiction features with Maborosi. Nobody Knows, Like Father, Like Son and Shoplifters examine childhood, care, poverty and the meaning of family; Shoplifters won the Palme d’Or. He also filmed in France and South Korea. Sheep in the Box extended his exploration of loss and kinship into artificial intelligence in 2026.
